## Seed history — run ONCE

Upload all your existing series PDFs (1104.pdf … 1123.pdf). They are saved to
`/home/node/.n8n-files/salla` on the server so the daily workflow can compare against them.
After this, use the **daily** workflow and never seed again.

parameters.formDescription: Upload ALL your previous order PDFs once. Filenames must be like 1123.pdf.
